outcome.description: resolved: the incident is handled (the issue is back on its way: with the worker, waiting, held or merged). owner: you could not resolve it within the premise, or were not sure; Talos hands the issue to the owner with your comment.

summary.description: One or two plain-text sentences: what you found and what you did, for the Talos log and the issue.

comment.description: HTML for the owner when the outcome is owner: what you saw, what you tried and what a person needs to do. Empty when resolved.
